name: creative-core
description: The pure-Swift engines of a Mac-native creative suite: the FlareCore animation engine plus the shared CoreColor, CoreRaster, CoreAsset, CoreCatalog, CoreRender and CoreRenderMetal modules. Linux-safe, Foundation only, except CoreCatalog, which uses GRDB over the system SQLite, and CoreRenderMetal, which uses Metal on macOS and builds empty on Linux. The Mac apps live in other repos.
